source.original_title: 05/14/2026 - Tristian Clunis & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/14/2026 - Tristian Clunis & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Follow Up

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: I was talking to your, I guess, a gentleman, Kim

prospect.name: Tristian Clunis
prospect.family_status: Married 16 years, one young son, wants more kids
prospect.training_background: Bodybuilding / bro split, did 75 Hard. Trains 5-6x/week, walks 45-60 min daily.

signals: Already fit and disciplined; wants good → great, not rescue
Has business coaches and mentors already; understands and values paid coaching
Frames fitness as a ripple effect into business, fatherhood, marriage
Explicitly not price-skeptical: 'I'm actually more interested in it because of the fact that it costs six grand'

goals.text: Drop from 18% to 12% body fat and hold it consistently
Be able to play with his kid indefinitely; longevity
Improve mobility and athleticism, not just aesthetics
Inspire his wife to re-engage with her own fitness

pains.text: Fell off after peak condition; cannot sustain results
Body no longer responds the same at 40; slower injury recovery
Fitness apps don't align nutrition + mobility + training
Has never had accountability for fitness the way he does in business

objections.raw_quote: I'm prepping to sell this house, there's different things that I'm doing right now... for me to make this investment right now, it might not be the right time
objections.rep_response: Let me go back to the team. Maybe there's something that we can help you out with. Are you open to popping another call tomorrow?

objections.raw_quote: So I'll be honest, the investment is an investment... can you make that investment right now? That's the question
objections.rep_response: My intention is to never take food off people's tables. If there's a way we can structure this that works with your finances, are you open to exploring that?
objections.note: Prospect said yes to exploring, but the rep ran out of time and deferred instead of structuring it live.

objections.raw_quote: do you find that people stay with the program? Or is it just kind of like a, they tried out for a year or so
objections.rep_response: We have a philosophy of teaching you how to fish, as opposed to giving you the fish. Once you're done, you're done.

objections.raw_quote: I've never done kettlebells like this. And so this is kind of like more trusting the system
objections.rep_response: Shared own story: healed ACL/MCL injuries via Trevor's program, now only does kettlebells and Muay Thai

offer.guarantee_mentioned: If you don't hit the goals set with Trevor in 6 months, we work with you for free until you do

evidence: Rep: 'Are you open to popping another call tomorrow?' — prospect: 'Yeah'
Time confirmed for ~6 o'clock next day
No payment taken, no link sent
Prospect repeatedly affirms belief in the program; blocker is timing of cash, not conviction

notable.note: Rep had to leave for his next call at the exact moment the prospect opened the door to payment structuring. High-intent prospect lost to a calendar collision, not to an objection.

quality.notes: Frequent short-turn swaps, especially in rapport sections. All quoted objections verified against surrounding context.
